title: Secret catalog
description: Open metadata for the encrypted secret store in secrets/catalog.yaml. Values never appear here; every field is safe to read without the installation key.

secrets.description: One entry per stored secret, sorted by id.

id.description: Stable identifier, also the name of the envelope file under secrets/values/.

scope.description: Who the secret belongs to: the installation itself, or one project binding.

purpose.description: What the secret is for, in plain words. Read by a recovery that cannot open the value.

environment.description: Environment variable name this value materializes into, when it materializes at all.

materialize.description: Where the value is written on materialize. Present only for a secret some file on the host must hold.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp of the first write, RFC 3339.

target.description: runtime-env is this installation's own env file, whose path role_env resolves at write time; file names any other env file.

path.description: Target file for the 'file' target, absolute or relative to the instance directory. The 'runtime-env' target must not carry one.
